svg.title: Cheminformatics Microservice: CDK, RDKit and Open Babel, unified behind one REST API and web app. A cord switchboard for the Cheminformatics Microservice. Three jacks on the panel stand for the CDK, RDKit and Open Babel toolkits. A request plug rides a carriage along the keyshelf, is patched into one jack, the lamp over that jack lights and the display shows the canonical SMILES that toolkit returned for caffeine.
